title: Implement Streaming with Suspense
description: Add a loading skeleton and a Suspense boundary to a page that fetches product data.
problemStatement:
## Goal Convert a traditional product listing page to use streaming with Suspense, so the page shell loads instantly while the product list streams in. ### Requirements 1. Create an App Router page at `app/products/page.js`. 2. Move the product fetching logic into a separate Server Component `components/ProductList.js` that returns a `
    ` of products. 3. In `app/products/page.js`, render a `

    Products

    ` and wrap `` in a `` boundary with a fallback of `

    Loading products...

    `. 4. Also create a `loading.js` file at `app/products/loading.js` that renders a styled skeleton (e.g., a grid of gray boxes). 5. Verify: when you navigate to `/products`, the header appears immediately, the loading skeleton shows, and then the product list replaces it. ### Notes - Use `fetch` to a public API like `https://fakestoreapi.com/products` with a delay simulation (`?delay=2000`) to see the streaming effect. - The `loading.js` covers the entire page; the manual `` is for additional granularity. You can remove one to test the other.
hints: The `ProductList` component should be `async` and directly fetch data.
Add `export const dynamic = 'force-dynamic'` to prevent static generation during dev (optional).
The `loading.js` file goes in the same folder as `page.js`.
expectedOutput: The page loads the title and skeleton instantly; the product list appears after the simulated delay without blocking the rest of the page.
